{{Recipe}}

'''Agbalumo smoothie''' is a delicious Nigerian smoothie made from African star apples.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:African Star Apple|African star apple]], washed
* Water
* [[Cookbook:Honey|Honey]] or [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]]
* Cup

== Procedure ==

# Peel the skin off the star apples and remove the seeds.
# Transfer the peeled fruit to the blender.
# Begin blending the fruit, adding water to get your desired consistency.
# Sweeten to taste with honey or sugar.
# Strain the smoothie through a [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]], and serve.
